purpose: Lock fresh-seed prediction rules before evaluating fresh full-residual trajectories

decision_rules.barrier_classification: Require agreement on whether at least ceil(0.1 W) slopes cross each threshold at the horizon
decision_rules.nonfinite_or_incomplete: Report separately; never treat as a successful prediction

interpretation: Rules were set after inspecting the original-seed degree-33 forecasts, before running fresh-seed full-residual validation. They validate numerical predictive adequacy, not a rigorous trajectory enclosure. The law PDE has no single-seed acceptance claim; compare quadrature error and original/fresh seed dispersion.
